name: Towers and Bunkers
summary: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains asks you to capture an enemy tower. The stronghold's defenses are at stake.

sections.title: The Assignment
sections.body: An enemy tower is the prize Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl sets before you in the Alterac Mountains. Capture it, then return to her. The order leaves the tower's hold in question.

faq.answer: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl gives the order in the Alterac Mountains.
Teeka asks you to capture an enemy tower.
After capturing an enemy tower, return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

attribution: In-game quest text: Towers and Bunkers
